title: Snowy Hub | Auto Drive, Auto Car, Skin Changer & More
features:
Autopilot and driving

Auto Drive – Enables an advanced autopilot that handles steering, acceleration, and braking.

Target Speed – Sets the autopilot cruising speed from 150 to 280 mph.

Pass Distance – Adjusts the spacing used when overtaking vehicles from 8 to 22 studs.

Minimum Gap – Sets the minimum distance maintained from vehicles ahead from 5 to 18 studs.

Caution Level – Adjusts the autopilot's driving aggression from 0% to 100%.

Seek Overtakes – Allows the autopilot to actively look for opportunities to pass other vehicles.

Avoid Crashes – Helps avoid collisions with vehicles and obstacles.

Keep Level – Stabilizes the vehicle to keep it level with the road during high-speed driving.

Route recording and pathing

Record Route – Records a custom driving line or lap while you drive manually.

Follow Route – Automatically follows a previously recorded driving route.

Clear Route – Deletes the currently recorded route.

Route Status – Displays whether a route is recording, idle, or currently being followed.

Garage and customization

Car Spawner – Automatically identifies and spawns the best owned vehicle based on top speed, horsepower, and price.

Car Skin Changer – Replaces the current vehicle model with another available car model.

Car List Refresh – Refreshes the vehicle list with currently available cars.

Restore Own Car – Restores the original vehicle model after using a different skin.

Live status monitoring

Current Speed – Displays your current speed in mph.

Overtakes – Tracks the number of successful overtakes during the session.

Per Minute – Displays the average overtake rate.

Combo Left – Shows the remaining time on the current overtake combo.

Autopilot State – Displays the current autopilot state, such as Engaging, Scanning, Routing, or Error.

Car Name – Displays the name of the current vehicle.

Interface and session

Menu Keybind – Changes the key used to toggle the SnowyHub interface, defaulting to RightShift.

Watermark – Displays a compact on-screen overlay with current statistics.

Unload – Stops the autopilot, restores the vehicle skin, and removes the script from the session.
